purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Brescia

queries.query: Brescia Italy official cadastral map parcels geoportale WMS Comune di Brescia
queries.result: First-party Regione Lombardia Geoportale and Provincia di Brescia SIT cadastral map pages were found. The regional metadata says cadastral maps are viewable online and expose section, sheet, and parcel on map click; it also says the maps cannot be downloaded.

queries.query: Brescia catasto mappa particelle portale ufficiale Comune Regione Lombardia
queries.result: The same first-party regional cadastral metadata and the official Provincia di Brescia Catasto page were returned. The province page documents cadastral map coverage and links its public cartography viewer.

registryEvidence: First-party regional and provincial public cadastral map services are evidenced; this is map access and not evidence of an open downloadable parcel API or ownership registry.

officialSources.observation: Regione Lombardia metadata for Mappe catastali: online map consultation, map-click section/foglio/particella information, and no download of the cadastral maps.
Provincia di Brescia official SIT Catasto page links the public cadastral cartography and identifies cadastral map content and extent.

Official Lombardia cadastral viewer URL exposed by the metadata page; viewer HTML was reachable, but its configuration asset did not return a usable public config/feature endpoint during this attempt.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Regione Lombardia cadastral map viewer is regional; Provincia di Brescia SIT page describes cadastral coverage for the province and links its viewer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official map pages and viewer shells were reachable, but no safe anonymous parcel identity/geometry feature response was verified for Brescia.

remainingUncertainty: The map viewers may expose parcel outlines and section/foglio/particella interactively, but this attempt did not obtain a bounded machine-readable feature response. Exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point miss, map extent, timeout, or viewer/config failure was treated as citywide absence. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained. No GeoJSON sample is included because no stable native parcel identity and full polygon were observed. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
